data.title: Space Coast Meetup — table 4
data.transcript: Speaker 1: So you said you're doing CubeSat ground station work on the side? Speaker 2: Yeah, amateur, a Norse-themed program, we flew our first pass a couple weeks ago. Speaker 1: That's great. I'm Priya Venkataraman, I run thermal at Aldrin Microsystems, we do small-sat radiators. Speaker 2: Oh nice, I actually wrote something on orbital thermal bounds, I can send you the preprint. Speaker 1: Please do. And if you're ever near Melbourne, come see the vacuum chamber. Speaker 2: I'd love that. I'll email you next week. What's the best address? Speaker 1: priya at aldrin-micro dot example. Also, we're hiring a junior ops person in the spring, keep an eye out. Speaker 2: Will do, I'll check your careers page in March. Speaker 1: And send me that paper, I'll pass it to our lead. Speaker 2: Done, by Friday.

data.title: Coffee with a founder
data.transcript: Speaker 1: What do you do? Speaker 2: Day job is payroll implementation, and I do fractional program management for Vargrheim, a small aerospace outfit. Speaker 1: Cool. I'm Marcus Oyelaran, I do robotics for warehouses. Speaker 2: Send me a link to your arm demo, I'd like to see the controller. Speaker 1: Sure.

data.title: Voice memo — course notes
data.transcript: Reminder to self: chapter six problem set is due Sunday, and reread the lift equation derivation.

data.title: Hallway chat
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Long day. Speaker 2: Same. You seen the launch schedule for next month? Speaker 1: Not yet. Anyway, good talking, I'm Lena. Speaker 2: Dan. See you at the next one.
